summary.text: Sarge Pollock is a Republican state representative from Kentucky who has represented District 51 since 2021 and is seeking re-election to the Kentucky House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as Michael Pollock, also known as Sarge, and gives his profession as insurance.

paragraphs.text: Sarge Pollock, listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Pollock, earned a B.S. from Campbellsville University.
His career experience includes working with Jessie Insurance Agency, and he has volunteered with Green River Ministry.
He assumed office on November 29, 2021, succeeding John Carney (R).

In the 2025-2026 session Pollock was vice chair of the House Banking and Insurance Committee and also served on the House Agriculture, Families and Children, and Tourism and Outdoor Recreation committees.
